source_metadata.title: ESPN NBA game summary box scores

source_capture_warning: aggregate fetched_at is not per-game acquisition time; file contains preserved413 games plus later refresh; do not infer timestamp error from newest scheduled date alone
normalization_rule: parse fieldGoalsMade-fieldGoalsAttempted as total FG before legacy fg/FG aliases; preserve absent/invalid as missing, never0 default. Not implemented in production.
derived_recovery_rule: total FGM is algebraically recoverable when scoring components and independent teamFGM reconcile; FGA remains unknown outside direct source samples. No clamp, no2PM reinterpretation.
generated_boxscore_boundary: this is imported historical cache/parser evidence; no generated game boxscore defect inferred.
